name: rodex
description: RodeX v1 — personal database gateway platform (DynamoDB + Cloudflare)

scripts.dev:real: cross-env STORAGE=aws npm run dev -w gateway
scripts.deploy:dashboard: npm run build -w dashboard && wrangler pages deploy dashboard/dist --project-name rodexdb
scripts.test:packages: npm test --prefix packages/rodexdb && npm test --prefix packages/rodex-mcp
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --prefix packages/rodexdb && npm run build --prefix packages/rodex-mcp
